title: Block chain-based federated learning privacy protection method, system, device and medium

pse.problem: Limitation in protecting data content privacy in blockchain-based federal learning, neglecting client weight protection, and high computational cost for server aggregation model
pse.solution_function: Performs a blockchain-based federated learning with enhanced privacy protection by generating encryption keys, decryption keys, and using a master public key and master private key for secure data transmission. Maintains client weight protection during the training process to prevent indirect deduction of training data source.
pse.solution_structure: Involves a blockchain network, federated learning nodes (clients), a server, and cryptographic keys (master public key, master private key, encryption key, decryption key).
pse.solution_implementation: The process includes generating master public key and master private key by the server, distributing these to the clients. Clients use their own data to locally train a model and encrypt it using encryption keys before sharing with other clients on the blockchain. The aggregated model is decrypted by the server after verification.
pse.effect: Enhanced privacy protection for data content in federal learning, improved client weight protection, and reduced computational cost for the server aggregation model
